unit: Unit 3 ~ Unit 8 宾语从句专题
summary: 用一个句子作宾语。三要素：① 引导词 ② 陈述句语序 ③ 时态呼应（主句过去时，从句用相应过去时态）。
signals: 主句过去时 → 从句过去时态

rules.title: 引导词的选择
rules.detail: 从句是陈述句用 that（可省略）；一般疑问句用 if / whether（是否）；特殊疑问句用原疑问词（what, where, when, why, how...）。

examples.en: I want to know if it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我想知道明天是否下雨。

examples.en: Do you know where the station is?

rules.title: 从句必须用陈述句语序
rules.detail: 不管原句是疑问句还是陈述句，从句一律「主语 + 谓语」。❌ Do you know where is the station? → ✓ Do you know where the station is?

examples.en: Can you tell me how I can get to the hospital?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去医院吗？

examples.en: He asked what my name was.

rules.title: 时态呼应
rules.detail: 主句是现在时，从句时态随意（按实际）；主句是过去时（asked, said, wanted to know），从句要用相应的过去时态（一般过去时/过去进行时/过去将来时/过去完成时）。

examples.en: He said (that) he was doing his homework.
She asked if I had seen the film.
examples.zh: 她问我是否看过那部电影。

pitfalls: 从句用疑问语序：❌ I don't know where is he. → ✓ I don't know where he is.
主句过去时从句不呼应：❌ He said he will come. → ✓ He said he would come.
if/whether 后直接接 or not 时用 whether：whether or not

questions.explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序：where + he + lives；主句现在时，从句按实际用一般现在时。

questions.stem: She asked me ___ I could help her with the box.
questions.explain: 原句是「你能帮我吗？」一般疑问句，用 if（是否）引导。

questions.stem: He said that he ___ the movie before.
questions.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，「看电影」发生在说的之前，用过去完成时 had seen。

options: what time will the train leave
what time the train will leave
what time the train leaves will
the train will leave what time
questions.explain: 用陈述语序：疑问词 + 主语 + will + 动词原形。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ ___ the bank is? (two words: 在哪里)
questions.explain: 陈述语序：where + the bank + is；「在哪里」用 where。

questions.stem: I believe ___ (that / if) you can pass the exam.
questions.explain: 从句是陈述句，引导词用 that（也可省略）；if 表示「是否」，意思不通。

questions.stem: He told me that he will visit the Great Wall the next week.
questions.explain: 主句 told 是过去时，从句的将来要变成过去将来时 would visit。

questions.stem: 我想知道你为什么迟到了。（翻译整句）
answer: i want to know why you were late.
i wonder why you were late.
questions.explain: why 引导宾语从句，用陈述语序：why + you + were late。

questions.stem: 请告诉我他是否已经完成了作业。（翻译整句）
answer: please tell me if he has finished his homework.
please tell me whether he has finished his homework.
questions.explain: 「是否」用 if/whether 引导；has finished 表示已完成。
